claims.claim_text: Arqit identified a prior period error in IFRS 2 share-based payment accounting and restated FY2024 (admin expenses up $2.237M) and FY2023 (admin expenses up $4.134M); had material weaknesses in prior years; effected a 25-for-1 reverse share split in September 2024; and recorded a $7.0M provision for a putative class-action settlement.

claims.object_value: Restatement of FY23/FY24 for SBP error; prior 2022 material weaknesses; 25-for-1 reverse split (Sep 2024); $7.0M class-action settlement provision (Oct 2025 term sheet)
claims.source_quote: During the year ended September, 30 2025, an error was identified in the application of IFRS 2 ... The provision relates to a legal settlement pertaining to the putative class action lawsuit filed against Arqit ...
